info.title: TetraFi RFQ API
info.description: Request-for-quote trading API. Get quotes and execute token swaps directly with market makers.

get.description:
## Overview
            Get a quote for the requested tokens and amounts. This endpoint allows you to request quotes for one-to-one trades as well as multi token trades (one-to-many and many-to-one).

            ## Executing the quote
            By default this is a gasless quote and will need to be submitted to [`/order`](#/v3/post_order_v3_order_post)

            Specifying `gasless=false` to the API will return `tx` that can be used to self execute. You may also specify `skip_validation` for use cases where validations are a constraint.

post.description:
This endpoint provides a simple order placement mechanism for quotes retrieved from [/quote](#/v3/v3_quote_v3_quote_post) endpoint. You will be required to sign the quote object using an EOA private key and POST this signature along with the quote ID to place an order.

            TetraFi submits order on chain having received maker and taker signatures. This means that TetraFi pays the network (gas) fees as they are already included in the price.
